title: Portable workbench compatibility decision
rule_13_invariant: No academic approval inferred from software validation.

decision.rationale: The native v3.5 portable workbench contract (packageVersion 1.0.0, componentApiVersion 0.1.0, transformationIrVersion 0.1.0, adapterApiVersion 0.2.0, scenePackageVersion 1.0.0) is strictly typed, data-only, declarative, and specifies fail-closed rejection requirements (blocking executable payloads, pixel placements, version mismatches, and ungrounded canonical claims). Grade9v4.2 adopts a reuse adapter contract that enforces native rejection rules, preserves exact semantic transforms and provenance, and guarantees zero runtime duplication unless an external decision mandates otherwise.

Package transformationIrVersion differs from host expected transformationIrVersion (0.1.0)
